events.title: Demo Available!
events.summary: The demo for Divided Empire: Sengoku is finally up! Please give it a try and leave some feedback in the Community Hub if you have the time. Your opinions and ideas are very valuable to me :)The game is still in development, so I apologize in advance for any bugs etc. you might encounter.Wishing you good luck in reuniting Japan!

events.title: Dev Diary #2: Districts & Splinters

events.title: Dev Diary #1: Castles
events.summary: Greetings! Welcome to the first dev diary for Divided Empire: Sengoku! Today we’ll look into one of my favorite things about feudal Japan: the castles! The world map of DE:S is made up of “Districts”; geographic territories where you collect taxes, construct buildings, recruit soldiers, and much more.
